decisions.decision: The board agreed to make the listed edits to the draft APD bylaw, beginning with Section 1 (Purpose) (d) and (e) and Section 2 (Alteration Substantial), and continuing page by page through Section 12.
decisions.quote: changes will be made to section 1: purpose (d), (e), and section 2: alteration substantial.

decisions.decision: The board agreed that the written determination deadline in Section 8 (Binding Review) and Section 10 would be 90 days after application submittal instead of the 60 days currently in place.
decisions.quote: it will also be noted that written determination shall be no later than 90 days after application submittal instead of the 60 currently in place.
